modified range VFX are still visible around the champion model. * ''Burst Fire'' can apply the effect of {{ii|Horizon Focus}} when the enemy hit is within the last 50 units of this ability.{{bug|2}} * ''Burst Fire'' uses a modified icon when empowered by {{ai|Spark Surge|Zeri}} ([[File:Zeri Burst Fire 2.png|20px|link=]]) and {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} ([[File:Zeri Burst Fire 3.png|20px|link=]]) as well as both ([[File:Zeri Burst Fire 4.png|20px|link=]]). * Destroying a ward that is targetable but not visible to '''Zeri's''' team (e.g. a {{ii|Control Ward}} in [[Fog of War]]) via ''Burst Fire'' uniquely allows her to remove its accompanying [[Ward#Ward_Timers|ward timer]] (if it exists) without seeing the ward being destroyed. * If '''Zeri''' is affected by an ally {{cai|Tempered Fate|Bard}} during ''Burst Fire's'' cast time, she will be able to cast it during the effect.{{bug}} * The {{sti|ad|{{as|bonus AD}}}} calculates off of excess {{sti|as|{{as|bonus attack speed percent|as}}}} - not the raw excess {{as|attack speed}}. ** For example, if she has {{#vardefineecho:example_bonus_as|150}}% {{as|bonus attack speed percent}}, but needs only {{#vardefineecho:example_cap_bonus_as|135}}% to reach the {{#var:as_cap}} attack speed cap, she will gain {{#var:excess_as_to_ad_ratio}}{{times}}({{#var:example_bonus_as}}{{minus}}{{#var:example_cap_bonus_as}}){{equals}}{{#var:excess_as_to_ad_ratio}}{{times}}{{#vardefineecho:example_excess_as|{{#expr: {{#var:example_bonus_as}} - {{#var:example_cap_bonus_as}}}}}}{{equals}}{{#expr: {{#var:excess_as_to_ad_ratio}} * {{#var:example_excess_as}}}} {{as|AD}} ** The excess {{as|attack speed}} is calculated after any [[Crowd control#Cripple|cripple effects]] (like {{iis|Frozen Heart}} {{nie|Winter's Caress}}), meaning they can reduce both her {{as|attack speed}} and {{as|attack damage}}. ** The excess {{as|attack speed}} is calculated before {{cai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} applies its effects. Using it won't change the {{as|attack damage}}, despite her gaining additional attack speed and the cap changing. }}
